cells.scene: An adult studies a thick well-organized guide containing maps, photos, diagrams and many reference pages, breadth of coverage clearly visible.
An old roadside stone milestone stands beside a country road, simple distance numerals visible, not a celebratory trophy.
A small region of landscape is enclosed by a clearly marked boundary line, a village and fields inside that same territory.
A car odometer or milometer displays accumulated travel distance as a row of mechanical number wheels beside the speedometer, close dashboard detail.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — comprehensive (a.广泛的；丰富的): An adult studies a thick well-organized guide containing maps, photos, diagrams and many reference pages, breadth of coverage clearly visible.
TOP RIGHT — milestone (n.里程碑): An old roadside stone milestone stands beside a country road, simple distance numerals visible, not a celebratory trophy.
BOTTOM LEFT — territory (n.领地；地区): A small region of landscape is enclosed by a clearly marked boundary line, a village and fields inside that same territory.
BOTTOM RIGHT — milometer (n.计程表): A car odometer or milometer displays accumulated travel distance as a row of mechanical number wheels beside the speedometer, close dashboard detail.
CROP SAFETY: each scene is SMALL, at most 60% of its quadrant, with 20% white margins. Top drawings fully end ABOVE 45% image height. Bottom-row heads, hair, thought bubbles and main objects begin BELOW 58% total image height. Nothing crosses midlines. Sparse background detail, light watercolor.
review_notes: Three cells passed. Milometer target is clear, but adjacent speedometer repeats 140, so replacement removes gauge and isolates odometer.
